changelog: DeskAI v2.4.0 (Build 28): The canvas. Ask the agent to draft something (a guide, a TikTok script, an email, a plan) or to show how a website page would look, and it opens as a card you can tap. Refine it in chat ("punchier intro"), flip between versions, and say "publish it" when it's ready. Also includes build 27: the agent's morning brief and questions in your chat.
